case_title: HUANG BAOJIA VS CAPITAL RESTAURANT EQUIPMENT CO

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY HUANG BAOJIA AS TO DEFENDANT CAPITAL RESTAURANT EQUIPMENT CO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-11-1991 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 02

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HUANG BAOJIA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CAPITAL RESTAURANT EQUIPMENT CO $933.75 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $933.75 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
